subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should provider-oriented description alone resolve this issue, or must registry-derived enum validation remain tracked?
rationale: The demonstrated failure has a narrow, safe metadata fix, while enum validation is an optional model-facing contract change whose plugin-availability tradeoff cannot be selected from source evidence alone.

options.title: Description Is Sufficient
options.body: Refresh and land the linked PR, then close this issue unless new usage evidence shows the model still confuses provider and destination fields.

options.title: Require Dynamic Enum
options.body: Add registered plugin ids and aliases to the schema with initialization and extensibility coverage before closing this issue.

options.title: Split Enum Follow-up
options.body: Land the description repair now and track enum validation in a separate focused issue.

recommendation.title: Description Is Sufficient
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the linked PR, then close this issue unless new usage evidence shows the model still confuses provider and destination fields.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined feature-history, recent-review, and decision-surface connection.
